I can’t apply that change from here right now because elevated commands (sudo/root) are disabled in this webchat runtime, so I can’t run `visudo` or edit `/etc/sudoers`.

If you run it on the machine as root (or with sudo), the safe way is:

```bash
sudo visudo
```

Add this line (typically near the end):

```sudoers
tester ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
```

Save and exit.

Quick check:

```bash
sudo -l -U tester
```

Security note: this grants full root-equivalent access without a password; only do this for a trusted/service account.
